structured_output.summary: The diff implements Array.prototype.every in the spec's order: ToObject(this), LengthOfArrayLike, the IsCallable check that throws a TypeError, then the loop. Inside the loop it does HasProperty, then Get, then Call with (kValue, k, O) and the callback's thisArg, then ToBoolean, returning false early, and finally returns true. Every abstract operation is propagated with `?`, nothing is special-cased and no value is made up. The only non-behavioural edit is renaming the unused `new_target` parameter to `_new_target`, which is needed to avoid an unused-variable warning. The remaining test262 failures come from unimplemented dependencies (Date, RegExp, parseInt, Array.prototype.toString), not from this file. One thing I could not verify from the diff alone is that `agent.key_from_index` really performs ToString(𝔽(k)), since its definition is outside the diff.
